notes: Time-to-Power schedule arithmetic. Lead-time streams are reused from the anchors already carried in Ch07 (IEA / LBNL). Ch07 states explicitly that the 4-8 year transmission figure is a broad grid-build clock and NOT a project-specific AI-data-center lead time; it is used here only as a reference band into which a reader substitutes project-specific durations. Ramp shapes and compounding factors are report-side illustrations. No new numeric identities.

interconnection_transmission.anchor: IEA via Ch07 Table 7.2: new transmission 4-8 years in advanced economies
interconnection_transmission.grade: A for the institutional anchor, D as a project lead time

large_power_transformer.anchor: IEA via Ch07 Table 7.2: up to 4 years procurement; 0 because the stream need not be binding
large_power_transformer.grade: A for the institutional anchor, D as a project lead time

site_construction.anchor: IEA via Ch07 §5A: cables 2-3 years procurement; used here as the site/equipment build clock
site_construction.grade: A for the institutional anchor, D as a project lead time

compounding_factors.note: Product of the three factors converts announced GW into revenue-bearing GW. Each factor is a dial; none is measured by this report.
